iris-blue.$description: Iris Blue — Brand borders, gradient text fills, icon strokes, link accents — the dominant chromatic identifier across the entire site; Hero background radial glow — the atmospheric blue light at the top of the page

cobalt.$description: Cobalt — Primary action button fill, active states — the only solid color button in the system; Violet action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

sky-glow.$description: Sky Glow — Secondary blue accent for illustrations and decorative icon strokes

mint-pulse.$description: Mint Pulse — Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

midnight-iris.$description: Midnight Iris — Link border accent, gradient text deep stop

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, dominant border color, nav text, heading text — the structural dark of the system

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text, inverted surfaces

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Hero gradient origin, soft section backgrounds — gives the page its daylight wash

pale-slate.$description: Pale Slate — Secondary surface, input backgrounds, hairline border variant

dove-gray.$description: Dove Gray — Icon strokes, muted borders, secondary button borders — cool-toned mid-gray

iron.$description: Iron — Body text muted, secondary button text, supportive UI labels

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary text, helper copy, table row metadata

slate-mist.$description: Slate Mist — Icon stroke variant, heading accent borders, decorative line work

selecta.$description: Display and headline serif — the only decorative typeface, used exclusively for hero/page-level headlines with tight negative tracking. The choice of a high-contrast serif for an AI devtool is the system's signature: it signals editorial confidence against an otherwise utilitarian sans-serif body. Tightest tracking at 86px (-0.025em ≈ -2.15px) tightens to -0.015em at 40px, loosening as size decreases.

suisse-intl.$description: Primary UI typeface — body text, nav, buttons, cards, icons labels, badges. Carries the entire system except headlines. Weight 450 (the unusual mid-weight) is the signature body weight; 500 for emphasis and nav items. Tracking opens positive (0.04–0.05em) at the smallest sizes (8–10px) to keep tiny UI labels legible.

geist-mono.$description: Code snippets, tab labels in the product mockup, file path labels, technical micro-copy. Most distinctive use: extreme 0.15em tracking on the smallest sizes (the "What's the problem?" eyebrow label style), creating an all-caps, wide-tracked technical eyebrow that contrasts the serif headline below it.

geist-sans.$description: Fallback/secondary sans for specific UI clusters where Geist Mono's monospace character isn't needed but a lighter weight sans is. Used sparingly — Suisse Intl does the heavy lifting.
